dataset: polyvore (historical disjoint pool, 152,785 items; read from polyvore_outfits.zip)
label_definition: TRUE = the same product photograph (re-encoded, resized, recompressed, lightly cropped/edited copies, background changes); FALSE = a different product, a different photograph, or a colour/metal variant of the same product.
labelling: Owner seed (10 pairs) plus pairs sampled with fixed numpy seeds from the pHash Hamming<=2 candidate list and labelled blind (metrics hidden) by visual side-by-side inspection; labeller = Claude agent, not the owner.

sampling.stratified_by_thumb_mad: seed 20261119; 66 pairs stratified over whole-thumbnail MAD bins
sampling.boundary_round1: seed 20261120; 24 pairs near the first candidate rule's boundary
sampling.boundary_round2: seed 20261121; 24 pairs within 0.6-1.6x of the boundary of an intermediate rule (Delta a*b*<=3, fg-MAD16<=13)
sampling.uniform_random_holdout: seed 20261122; 36 pairs uniformly from candidates not previously labelled; labelled AFTER the final thresholds were fixed

rule_selection: Thresholds chosen on the 124 'fit' pairs: among two-feature rules (Delta a*b*, CIELAB p95 Delta E, foreground MAD, ...), the one with maximal recall subject to zero accepted FALSE; then rounded (Delta a*b* 1.997->2.0, p95 Delta E 15.46->15.0). Aspect ratio could not be calibrated (all Polyvore images are 300x300) and is off.
population_effect: Polyvore pool: 2,963 pHash<=2 candidate pairs -> 1,257 confirmed; 2,359 items in 1,150 groups (largest 6).
